title: English Language and PD Trainer
description:
English Language & Personality Development Trainer cum Content Writer 
 Organisation: Chandigarh University, Mohali
 Job Location: Mohali, Punjab | Work Mode: Onsite
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 Days)
 Experience: 3+ Years
 Qualification: Graduation in any discipline
 Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct engaging and effective English Language, Communication Skills, and Personality Development training sessions for students. Prepare and mentor students for campus placement drives. Develop engaging training materials, activities, exercises, and other content as required . Maintain a high standard of teaching quality and student engagement . Support students in improving their spoken English, grammar, vocabulary, confidence, presentation, and interpersonal skills . 
 Eligibility & Skills Minimum Graduation in any discipline. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in English Language Training, Personality Development, Soft Skills Training, Communication Skills Training, or a similar domain. Excellent English communication and grammar skills . Strong presentation, interpersonal, and classroom management skills. Good content development and writing skills. 

 Immediate joiners and candidates based in/around Mohali, Chandigarh, and Tricity are preferred. 
 Apply Now Interested candidates can share their updated CV or connect directly: Divya divya.e17055@cumail.in 8360111208
